summary: Fix 3 critical authentication bugs: BUG-001 (token loss during registration), BUG-002 (admin UI visible without DB verification), BUG-003 (WorkOS session persists after logout). Priority order: BUG-001 > BUG-003 > BUG-002.

phases.name: BUG-001: Token Loss During Registration
phases.description: Fix critical token loss that blocks ALL new user registrations. Tokens are lost when AdminAuthCallback navigates to /register/choose-role without preserving URL parameters.

subtasks.description: Fix AdminAuthCallback.tsx line 53: Preserve URL query parameters (accessToken, refreshToken, userId, sessionId) when navigating to redirectPath. Currently uses navigate(redirectPath) which loses all URL params. Must construct URL with params preserved: navigate(`${redirectPath}?accessToken=${accessToken}&refreshToken=${refreshToken}&userId=${userId}&sessionId=${sessionId}`)
acceptanceCriteria: navigate() call includes all URL params
accessToken, refreshToken, userId, sessionId preserved in URL

subtasks.description: Update ChooseRole.tsx: Add sessionId extraction from URL params (line 10-12 area), pass sessionId to registration forms via URLSearchParams. Currently only passes accessToken, refreshToken, userId. Must add: const sessionId = searchParams.get('sessionId') || '' and include in params object.
acceptanceCriteria: Token validation: if any required param is empty, show error instead of proceeding

subtasks.description: Update workos-auth.tsx loginAsEmployer signature: Add sessionId parameter to loginAsEmployer function (currently takes workosUserId, accessToken, refreshToken). Update the login() call inside to include sessionId. Reference useAdminAuth loginAsAdmin pattern which already accepts sessionId.
acceptanceCriteria: loginAsDoctor accepts sessionId as 4th parameter (same pattern)
sessionId stored in localStorage auth object
useEmployerAuth returns sessionId (add to return object)
useDoctorAuth returns sessionId (add to return object)

subtasks.description: Update EmployerRegistrationForm.tsx: Extract sessionId from URL params (line 18-20 area), add validation that workosUserId and accessToken are non-empty before form submission, pass sessionId to loginAsEmployer call. Show error UI if tokens are missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Validation: if workosUserId or accessToken empty, show error message
Form submission blocked if tokens missing

phases.gateCondition: All BUG-001 subtasks complete AND typecheck passes. Token flow verified: AdminAuthCallback -> ChooseRole -> EmployerRegistrationForm preserves all 4 tokens (accessToken, refreshToken, userId, sessionId).

phases.name: BUG-003: WorkOS Session Persistence After Logout
phases.description: Fix session persistence issue where WorkOS session cookie remains after app logout. Employer and Doctor layouts need to call WorkOS logout endpoint with sessionId, matching the pattern already implemented in AdminLayout.

subtasks.description: Update EmployerLayout.tsx: Add handleLogout function matching AdminLayout pattern (lines 45-56). Import sessionId from useEmployerAuth (now available after task-1.3). Replace onClick={logoutEmployer} with onClick={handleLogout}. handleLogout must: call logoutEmployer(), clear localStorage, clear sessionStorage, redirect to ${CONVEX_URL}/auth/logout?sessionId=${sessionId}
acceptanceCriteria: handleLogout function implemented matching AdminLayout pattern
Logout button calls handleLogout instead of logoutEmployer directly
Redirects to WorkOS logout endpoint with sessionId

subtasks.description: Update DoctorLayout.tsx: Add handleLogout function matching AdminLayout pattern. Import sessionId from useDoctorAuth (now available after task-1.3). Replace onClick={logoutDoctor} with onClick={handleLogout}. Same implementation as EmployerLayout fix.
acceptanceCriteria: handleLogout function implemented matching AdminLayout pattern
Logout button calls handleLogout instead of logoutDoctor directly
Redirects to WorkOS logout endpoint with sessionId

phases.gateCondition: Both layout files updated with proper logout handling. Typecheck passes. All three portals (Admin, Employer, Doctor) now use consistent logout pattern with WorkOS session termination.

phases.name: BUG-002: Admin UI Access Without DB Verification
phases.description: Add database verification to prevent non-admin users from seeing admin UI. Currently useAdminAuth only checks localStorage role, not the adminUsers table. This is defense-in-depth since backend already blocks unauthorized access.

subtasks.description: Update AdminLayout.tsx: Add Convex query to verify user exists in adminUsers table. Import useQuery from convex/react. Query api.adminUsers.getByWorkosId with userId from adminUser. If query returns null (not found in adminUsers), show 'Admin Access Denied' message instead of admin content. Keep existing backend protection as fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: Loading state handled while query pending
If query returns null, show access denied UI
If query returns admin record, show normal admin content
Existing isAdminAuthenticated check still in place

phases.gateCondition: AdminLayout verifies user against adminUsers database before rendering. Non-admin users with forged tokens see access denied instead of admin UI.

phases.name: Verification & Testing
phases.description: Verify all fixes work together via Browser-CLI E2E testing. Test registration flow, logout flow, and admin access control.

subtasks.description: E2E verification using Browser-CLI: Test complete registration flow - navigate to landing, initiate login, complete WorkOS OAuth (manual step), verify tokens preserved through ChooseRole to EmployerRegistrationForm. Verify localStorage contains valid workosUserId and sessionId after registration.
acceptanceCriteria: Registration flow completes without token loss

subtasks.description: E2E verification of logout: Using authenticated-employer saved state, test logout button. Verify redirect to WorkOS logout endpoint. Verify session cleared (clicking Provider Login shows WorkOS login form, not direct redirect to choose-role).
acceptanceCriteria: Logout button triggers redirect to WorkOS logout endpoint
Re-clicking Provider Login shows WorkOS auth form (not auto-redirect)

phases.gateCondition: All E2E tests pass. No regressions. BUG-001, BUG-002, BUG-003 verified fixed via browser testing.

risks.description: WorkOS OAuth callback URL may need updating if sessionId parameter handling changes
risks.mitigation: Test with real WorkOS OAuth flow, not just mocked localStorage

risks.description: Breaking change to loginAsEmployer/loginAsDoctor signatures may affect other callers
risks.mitigation: Search for all usages of these functions before modifying. Make sessionId optional with default empty string.

risks.description: Admin DB query may fail if adminUsers table/query doesn't exist or has different schema
risks.mitigation: Verify adminUsers.ts exports getByWorkosId query before implementing UI change

risks.description: CONVEX_URL environment variable needed for logout redirect - may differ between environments
